title: GUI (Bypass AntiCheat, Circle Reach, Find Champions & more!)
features:
This game is basically a matchmaking system game, It's like swords but with a different tool mesh...

Please comment errors you catch so it could be fixed asap!

-- > Client
* WalkSpeed
* JumpPower
* Anti-Ragdoll | Removes any ragdoll mechanics etc when added to your character
* No Ring-Area
* No Weapon Damage (Removes touchinterest off weapons on spawn)

-- > Miscellaneous
* Bypass Anti-Cheat (Anti Fly + Anti Fling)
* Circle Reach (Requires firetouchinterest | supports Synapse, Scriptware, Krnl & other exploits that have this function | Not made by me)
* Grab Briefcase (Instantly grab the Briefcase from above the ring without completing the minigame)
* Find Champions (Checks to see who is currently the holder of the Champs)

-- > Binds
* Break Seats (Hover your mouse over a commentary seat and press the bind you have set it too!.. Keep in mind it kills you in order to break it | Not made by me)

-- > Teleports
* Player Teleport
* Commentary
* Ring
* Stage
* Backstage

-- > Settings
* UI Toggle Bind
* Save Data (Toggles, Binds etc)
* Load Data (Toggles, Binds etc)
